observations.body: Jesus redirects a kingdom-time question toward Spirit-given power and widening witness, ascends, and the apostles return to Jerusalem for persistent shared prayer with the women and Jesus’ family.
observations.label: Power, witness, ascension, and united prayer precede the day

observations.body: The passage presents Receiving, witnessing, ascending, returning, and praying as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Receiving, witnessing, ascending, returning, and praying

observations.body: The passage places Jerusalem, Judea, Samaria, and the earth beside Receiving, witnessing, ascending, returning, and praying.
observations.label: Jerusalem, Judea, Samaria, and the earth

payload.posture: Read Acts 1:6–14 as one movement in Pentecost, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus redirects a kingdom-time question toward Spirit-given power and widening witness, ascends, and the apostles return to Jerusalem for persistent shared prayer with the women and Jesus’ family. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Pentecost.
payload.title: Power, witness, ascension, and united prayer precede the day
